comments.body: [NON-BLOCKING] Packit jobs failed. @podman-container-tools/packit-jobs please check. Everyone else, feel free to ignore.
Should we add a maximum size? Docker doesn't accept secrets of >500kb size, so might be sensible?

@mheon I see this check is done [here](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/main/vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/secrets/secrets.go#L165-L168) which is called from [abi.SecretCreate](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/main/pkg/domain/infra/abi/secrets.go#L56). However, unlinke in Docker, if it's oversized data, we return 500 in the status code.

I opened a GH issue #30230 for that, since I think it's not in the scope of this PR.
